---
name: Work
about: One deliverable an agent or a person can pick up from this issue alone
title: ""
labels: ""
---

**Why.** What is wrong or missing today, and who needs it.

**Build.** What to make, as a list. Name the files, commands and formats where you know them.

**Done when.** What can be checked: the tests that exist, the run that is green, the page that links to it.

**Depends on.** Issues that must be closed first, or "nothing". Say so if it can be built in parallel.

**Start here.** The files to read first.

**Only a person.** Any step from the list in `AGENTS.md` (approving a check, held-out material, a secret, the rules). Label the issue `needs-sean` and name the step, or write "nothing".

**Model spend.** "None", or the budget.

---
Milestone, priority (`P0`, `P1`, `P2`) and `agent-ready` are set by whoever files the issue.
Read `AGENTS.md` before starting: how to claim this, the rules for every change, and what only a person may do.
